title: Red Warrior Pose Sequence
description: Four sequential views of a female warrior with long dark hair in a high ponytail, wearing a red and black outfit with corset, short skirt, armored gauntlets and boots. She is shown in dynamic fighting stances from left to right, with the third panel showing bright yellow sparks and energy effects emanating from her fists.
prompt: A female warrior with long flowing dark hair in a high ponytail and bangs, wearing a red leather-like corset top with black accents, short red skirt, red gauntlets, and heavy black boots with red laces. She has pale skin and a determined expression. Shown in four sequential dynamic fighting poses against a plain gray background, progressing from left to right. In the third pose bright yellow sparks and light effects burst from her fists. Detailed digital painting style with strong lighting and fabric folds.
